enriched_description: Heavy wooden cart designed to be drawn by an ox, featuring a simple rectangular cargo bed mounted on two large solid wooden wheels. The cargo bed is constructed from thick wooden planks with low side rails and an open top. Wheels are solid disc-style or spoked wood with iron tire bands around the rim. A long wooden tongue or pole extends forward for attachment to an ox yoke. Construction is entirely wooden with iron hardware at stress points. Surface shows weathered unpainted wood with visible grain and joinery. Overall proportions are low and wide, with wheel diameter approximately half the bed height.

Transparent or translucent plastic breathing mask that covers the nose and mouth, connected to an oxygen supply tube. The mask body is molded clear plastic with a contoured shape fitting the facial profile. A soft cushioned rim seals against the face. An elastic strap or head harness secures the mask in position. A corrugated flexible tube connects to a port at the bottom or side of the mask. Some models have an attached reservoir bag. The mask surface is smooth glossy plastic with visible condensation during use. Dimensions approximately 12-15 cm wide by 10-12 cm tall.

Small rectangular package or bundle wrapped in paper, plastic, or foil material. Dimensions typically 5-15 cm wide by 8-20 cm tall by 1-5 cm thick. Surface shows printed branding, product information, and barcodes on the outer wrapper. Material may be glossy laminated paper, matte cardboard, metallic foil, or transparent plastic with heat-sealed edges. Contents create a slight bulge visible through the packaging. Edges are straight with clean folded seams. Some packets have a tear notch or perforated opening strip.

Short light oar with a flat blade at one end and a straight shaft handle, used without an oarlock. Total length approximately 1.5-2 meters. The blade is a flat oval or teardrop-shaped surface approximately 40-60 cm long by 15-25 cm wide, made of wood, plastic, or composite material. Shaft is a smooth cylindrical or slightly oval pole tapering from the blade to the grip end. Wood paddles show visible grain with a varnished glossy finish. Plastic paddles have a uniform matte or semi-gloss surface in bright colors. The grip end may have a T-handle or D-grip configuration.

Large circular wheel fitted with multiple flat rectangular paddles (blades) arranged radially around the circumference. Diameter ranges from 3-10 meters. The wheel structure consists of a central hub, radial spokes, and an outer rim to which the paddles are attached. Paddles are flat wooden or metal plates extending outward from the rim. Construction is painted wood or steel with a weathered surface. The wheel is mounted on a horizontal axle driven by an engine, partially submerged in water. Visible on the sides of paddle steamer boats, creating a distinctive churning water effect.

Detachable lock with a solid metal body and a U-shaped hinged shackle. Body is rectangular or rounded, approximately 4-8 cm wide by 3-6 cm tall by 1.5-3 cm thick, constructed from brass, steel, or hardened alloy. Surface is polished brass with a golden reflective finish, or chrome-plated steel with a silver mirror surface. The shackle is a thick metal loop that passes through the body and locks into place. Keyhole or combination dial is visible on the front or bottom face. Some models have a laminated steel body with visible layered construction.

Paint application tool consisting of a bundle of bristles attached to a handle. Bristles are natural hair (hog, sable) or synthetic fibers (nylon, polyester) bound together in a flat, round, or angled tip shape. Bristle length ranges from 1-5 cm with a smooth tapered profile. The ferrule is a metal band (aluminum, brass, or nickel-plated) crimped around the bristle base, connecting to a wooden or plastic handle. Handle is cylindrical or octagonal, 15-25 cm long, with a smooth painted or natural wood finish. Tip shape varies from pointed to flat to fan-shaped.

Two-piece loose-fitting nightclothes consisting of a jacket-style top and matching trousers. The top has a button-front or pullover design with a collar, long or short sleeves, and a chest pocket. Trousers have an elastic or drawstring waistband with a straight-leg cut. Fabric is soft cotton, flannel, silk, or synthetic blend with a smooth or brushed texture. Patterns include stripes, plaids, prints, or solid colors. Seams are visible at the shoulders, sides, and inseams. Overall fit is relaxed and comfortable with a draped silhouette.

Grand official residence characterized by monumental scale, ornate architectural detailing, and symmetrical facade design. Features include multiple stories with tall arched windows, decorative columns or pilasters, balustrades along the roofline, and a central entrance with a grand portico or staircase. Construction is stone, marble, or stucco with a light-colored polished surface. Roof may be flat with a parapet, mansard-style, or topped with domes and towers. Formal gardens, fountains, and gated courtyards surround the building. Overall proportions are wide and imposing with a length exceeding 50 meters.

Primitive wind instrument consisting of multiple cylindrical pipes of graduated lengths bound together in a row. Pipes are made of bamboo, reed, wood, or hollow cane with a smooth natural surface showing visible nodes and grain patterns. Pipe lengths decrease progressively from longest (20-40 cm) to shortest (5-10 cm), creating a stepped trapezoidal profile. Pipes are bound together with cord, twine, or wax at two or more points along their length. Each pipe is open at the top and closed at the bottom, producing different pitches when blown across the open end. Color ranges from natural tan to dark brown.
